resources.string: On-device text-to-speech with Gradium Phonon 31M (English). Speech never leaves the phone.

1. Download the voice model (a one-time download of a few tens of megabytes; Wi-Fi recommended). The internet is used only for this.
2. Tap "Play a sample" to check it.
3. Open the system text-to-speech settings and choose this app as the preferred engine.

To use another Phonon checkpoint, put its config.json, tokenizer.json, model.q8.gguf (or model.safetensors) and voices/ in a folder on the phone and import it.
Hello! This is Phonon, speaking on your phone, without the internet.
